ModMetadata.Name: Loulan Revived [StationeersLaunchPad]
ModMetadata.Author: vinus
ModMetadata.Description:
[h1]Loulan Revived[/h1] [b]WARNING:[/b] This is a StationeersLaunchPad Plugin Mod. It requires Bepinex to be installed with the StationeersLaunchPad plugin. See: https://github.com/StationeersLaunchPad/StationeersLaunchPad
Revives the iconic world of loulan.
Wreck spawning are in beta and may be unstable.
you can also go here to get the dll itself if you want to just put it in your bepinex/plugins folder: https://github.com/TerameTechYT/StationeersSharp/actions
